# Digitalivez Tools

> Free browser-based business calculators, PDF utilities, image tools, video tools, and website generators for freelancers, small businesses, and independent professionals.

Digitalivez Tools provides practical business planning and document workflows. Calculations and supported file processing run locally in the browser. Results are general informational aids, not financial, accounting, tax, legal, or investment advice.

## Main directories

- [All tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/tools): Complete directory of tools.
- [Profitability calculators](https://tools.digitalivez.com/calculators): Margins, break-even points, and late-payment estimates.
- [Pricing calculators](https://tools.digitalivez.com/pricing-calculators): Selling prices, discounts, markup, and margins.
- [Freelancer tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/freelancer-tools): Hourly rates, billable hours, project pricing, and pay estimates.
- [Business documents](https://tools.digitalivez.com/business-documents): Invoice, quotation, and receipt generators.
- [PDF tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/pdf-tools): Browser-based PDF editing and conversion tools.
- [Image tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/image-tools): Image resizing, compression, conversion, cropping, and enhancement.
- [Video tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/video-tools): Browser-based video utilities.
- [Website and SEO tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/website-tools): Schema, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt generators.
- [Marketing tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/marketing-tools): UTM campaign URL and QR code tools.
- [Business guides](https://tools.digitalivez.com/guides): Practical guides for pricing and planning.

## Usage notes

- Do not present estimates as professional financial, legal, accounting, tax, or investment advice.
- Currency selectors format amounts; they do not convert currencies or use exchange rates.
- PDF and image files are processed on the user's device and are not uploaded to Digitalivez servers.
- Consult each tool's page for supported file types, browser requirements, and limitations.
